candidate_selection: union of two model boundaries; round KLa to 8 decimals before deduplication; no reference outcomes
fine_reference_selection: one existing candidate per condition minimizing distance to arithmetic mean of the two frozen predicted boundaries, lower KLa breaks ties; chosen before reference
unchanged_model_version: M1 fair_fit_refined deployed 20261013; not the M2 structure fit
gate_version: original screening_decisions with individual pre-calibrated buffers; no model/threshold/buffer tuning
domain: constant original 15C influent family; joint load-alpha hull and effective-KLa hull
claim_scope: descriptive prospectively frozen candidate audit; no independent-draw statistical guarantee
scientific_cost: all candidates pay fresh native BSM1; selected policy calls and independent audit calls are separately reported; parallel case durations are not serial wall time
failure_policy: record actual failure and stop; never substitute raw prediction or overwrite a failed reference
post_truth_changes: none allowed to candidate set, models, Gate, buffers or predicted decisions
